captures.description: ALEXANARCH:NONWIKI, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-02: 'NonWiki is a verified, source-open digital encyclopedia hosted on Alexanarch NonWiki. It is constructed as a transparent alternative to traditional crowd-sourced encyclopedias by explicitly locking every assertion to a documented, verifiable source.' Key characteristics: 'Source-Grounded Entries' (every sentence cites its exact source passage); 'Tamper-Proof Proofs' (a saved copy, its original web address and a cryptographic hash); 'No Public Editing' ('Articles are automatically compiled from disclosed data registries and community-disclosed repositories through a published, verifiable sequence'); 'Context in Alexanarch: It acts as a metadata layer for Alexanarch—a decentralized, sovereign archive'. Four cards: the NonWiki page, the GitHub repository, the Wiki index, the home page.

atoms.evidence: NonWiki is a verified, source-open digital encyclopedia
